items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: There was a comic named Frank Fontaine.

ctx.x: Were there certain people that would come in as guests that were of questionable musical talent, that would try singing or whatever.
Sure. I won’t mention any names. And then surprisingly there were some people that you had no idea that they were able to do that. I didn’t. There was a comic named Frank Fontaine.
